pin_policy: Pin the upstream commits that match the RELEASED build players run, not the tip of `upcoming`. Elite Redux develops on `upcoming` and cuts ROM releases from it without tags or a release branch, so branch tip runs ahead of every playable ROM. That is invisible in a Pokedex but fatal for the randomizer: its LCG modulus is ABILITIES_COUNT (= max ability enum id + 1), so a single unreleased ability makes 100% of PID results wrong. These SHAs are the newest pair with ABILITIES_COUNT == 1034, matching v2.65beta; ABILITY_BUTTERFLY_WINGS = 1034 landed in er-config on 2026-04-26 and is the boundary. tests/test_oracle.py asserts the count against ER-nextdex's published (released-game) data -- keep that green when repinning.
